title: AWS Certified AI Practitioner (AIF-C01)

domains.title: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions

format_coverage: The real AIF-C01 exam uses four item types: multiple choice (one correct response, three distractors), multiple response (two or more correct responses among five or more options), ordering (place 3-5 responses in the correct sequence), and matching (pair responses against 3-7 prompts). All three are all-or-nothing scored where more than one selection is required. This mock supports three formats and approximates as follows. Multiple choice maps exactly to single_choice. Multiple response maps to multiple_response, all-or-nothing, same as the real exam. Matching is approximated by scenario_matching: you map scenarios onto a reused option set, which exercises the same discrimination, but the real item form pairs a fixed response list against a prompt list. Ordering is NOT supported: concepts that the real exam may test as an ordering item — pipeline and FM-lifecycle stage sequences, and ranking customization approaches by cost or complexity — are authored here as single-choice items over candidate sequences. You will meet ordering and true matching item mechanics for the first time in the real exam; the underlying concepts are covered, the interaction is not rehearsed. Note also that the real exam presents 65 questions in 90 minutes, of which 50 are scored and 15 are unscored pretest items that are not identified; this mock contains only scored-equivalent items.
